script_text: Stop! Libra, the stars are screaming at you right now. Venus, your ruling planet, is squaring Pluto in your seventh house of partnerships, igniting old fears with raw power. This tense aspect asks you to clear emotional debris before love can breathe again. Pluto's pressure makes surrender feel dangerous. Single? You feel intensely magnetic, but an old loyalty wound may surface, so don't rush into a fantasy just because Pluto makes your heart race; taken? Your bond may hit a power test, and you might feel controlled, so watch for silent manipulation rather than reacting loudly. Pluto also activates your tenth house of career, bringing a public breakthrough or workplace power clash. Protect your reputation and refuse any financial deal signed under pressure. Avoid over-explaining yourself to someone who thrives on mystery, because secrets feel safer. Follow for tomorrow's reading tonight.
